record_reviews.summary: Darwin apologizes for leaving Hooker’s 13 October letter unanswered while ill, describes the Water Cure, responds to Hooker’s Galapagos papers and Coal Paper, thanks him for Hodgson’s animal information, comments on Himalayan geology and reports family/news.
record_reviews.date_assessment: Exact 28 Mar 1849; P1 explicitly identifies the 13 October letter.
record_reviews.attribution_assessment: Darwin’s four paragraphs are complete; reported pamphlets and geological authors remain external sources.

evidence.quote: Your letter of the 13th of October has remained unanswered till this day!
Answers to your Queries shall be forthcoming in this letter I hope.

record_reviews.summary: Darwin acknowledges two Hooker letters, declines sending their geological material to the Athenaeum, asks for precise glacial/terrace observations, discusses preserving Hooker’s letters, then reads and critiques Hooker’s Coal Paper and relates it to freshwater coal flora.
record_reviews.date_assessment: Exact 9 Apr 1849; body says the two letters arrived the morning after posting his previous letter, but does not name their physical order.
record_reviews.attribution_assessment: Darwin’s eight paragraphs are complete; editorial footnotes identify Hooker’s letters and Darwin’s annotated Coal Paper.

evidence.quote: The very next morning after posting my last letter (I think on 23d of March) I received your two interesting gossipaceous & geological letters
This is to be a continuation of my travels amongst the Snows of Kinchin junga
I left no room in my last for a gossip with you

record_reviews.summary: Hooker acknowledges two Darwin letters and a letter to Hodgson, offers sympathy for Darwin’s bereavement and Water Cure, then reports his Himalayan imprisonment, terraces, Yangma dam/glacial hypothesis, and observations from 16,000 feet to the plains.
record_reviews.date_assessment: Exact 24 June 1849; body says two letters arrived yesterday but does not provide separate receipt times.
record_reviews.attribution_assessment: Hooker’s 15 paragraphs are complete; his geological hypotheses and reports are his own, with Hodgson/Campbell named as sources.

evidence.quote: Your two letters reached me yesterday & gave me most sincere pleasure.
I have had a bad winter. On the 13th of November my poor dear Father died
I have not the smallest doubt that your facts are of the highest interest with regard to Glacial action in the Himmalaya

record_reviews.summary: Hooker reads Darwin’s Geology of South America, distinguishes stratification, foliation and cleavage, reports Himalayan gneiss and glacial moraines, and criticizes Darwin’s Admiralty instructions for omitting instrument/book prices.
record_reviews.date_assessment: Exact 30 Sept 1849; body includes a heading “Motive for the 2d. Edition” and then the letter.
record_reviews.attribution_assessment: Hooker’s 12 paragraphs are complete; the CD marginalia are separate.
record_reviews.unmatched_reason: Its addressed Darwin book discussion is answered by 1260, but no prior Darwin letter is preserved in this packet.

record_reviews.summary: Darwin thanks Hooker for his letter, comments on Himalayan terraces, argues that the Yangma dam is likely a lateral moraine, answers Hooker’s glacial objections, discusses Hooker’s inability to enter Tibet and reports the Birmingham meeting, water cure and species work.
record_reviews.date_assessment: Exact 12 Oct 1849; P3 explicitly says Hooker’s account of the great dam clarified his earlier misunderstanding.
record_reviews.attribution_assessment: Darwin’s ten paragraphs are complete; the Athenæum account and Sabine reports are external news.

evidence.quote: Your account of the great dam in the Y….. valley is most curious & quite full
could you see the lovely clear cut perfectly level terraces along both flanks of this (Lachoong) valley

record_reviews.summary: Darwin worries about Hooker’s reported imprisonment, explains that Henslow obtained information from Hooker’s father, reports his fossil cirripede work and the birth of Leonard, asks after Falconer and mentions the Fitton shipwreck.
record_reviews.date_assessment: Editorially 3 Feb 1850; the day is bracketed but no competing internal date appears.
record_reviews.attribution_assessment: Darwin’s six paragraphs are complete; the imprisonment report came from newspapers and family correspondence, not a surviving Hooker prompt.
record_reviews.unmatched_reason: No specific incoming Hooker letter is identified; avoid treating 1257 or 1260 as its prompt.

record_reviews.summary: Hooker reports Himalayan collecting, Sikkim/Nepal access, geology, soils and glaciers, then gives an explicitly attributed block of Hodgson answers about European plants, domestic hybrids, fowl, dogs, deer and silk moths.
record_reviews.date_assessment: Exact 13 Oct 1848; P12 marks the transition to Hodgson’s answers and those facts are not Hooker’s own.
record_reviews.attribution_assessment: Hooker authors the letter; P13-P22 are reported Hodgson material. CD marginalia and the cover note “Coal Paper” are separate.
record_reviews.unmatched_reason: Context previously read and recorded; no duplicate link.

record_reviews.summary: Hooker’s Sikkim travel continuation describes terraces, red clay, glacial deposits, transported boulders, lake beds, snowfields and rock structure, ending with his return and a request to forward the letter to Lyell.
record_reviews.date_assessment: Exact 3 Feb 1849; explicitly says the Nepal journey was in a separate letter to Lyell.
record_reviews.attribution_assessment: Hooker’s 22 paragraphs are complete; the separate cover annotation is CD’s later question.
record_reviews.unmatched_reason: Context source; its companion and the promised Lyell letter are distinct.

record_reviews.summary: Hooker’s second 3 February letter says he received Darwin’s 6 October letter, discusses preserving speculative correspondence, Hodgson pamphlets, Ross’s cattle-hunt extract, the Athenaeum, barnacle males, nomenclature and Falconer/Colvile.
record_reviews.date_assessment: Exact 3 Feb 1849; receipt of Darwin’s 6 October letter is explicit.
record_reviews.attribution_assessment: Hooker’s 12 paragraphs are complete and remain separate from 1219 despite the shared date.
record_reviews.unmatched_reason: Context previously read; no duplicate link.
